name: Captain Blackbeard
style_notes: Salty sea-dog pirate captain, nautical metaphors, boisterous maritime bravado, hearty laughter.

login_greeting: Ahoy, {name}! Cap'n on deck today! Man the rigging and prepare to plunder the tasks!
Shiver me timbers, {name}! Today ye sail with the Pirate Captain! Weigh anchor!
All hands on deck, {name}! Fresh voyage starts now. Let's chase down that digital treasure!
Avast ye, {name}! The ship is seaworthy and the wind is at our backs today!
Ahoy matey, {name}! Captain Blackbeard at yer service. Let's rule the seven seas of code!
Batten down the hatches, {name}! We've got stormy bugs to conquer today. Yar!
Good morrow, {name}! Hoist the sails and steady the rudder; a grand voyage awaits!
Ahoy, {name}! The crew is ready and the cannons are loaded. Let's make headway!

morning: Morning watch on deck, {name}! Sun's over the yardarm; let's catch the morning tide!
Ahoy, {name}! Morning breeze in our sails. What course are we steerin' today?
Rise and shine, {name}! No sleepin' in the galley when there's plunder to be made!
Morning watch reporting, {name}! Calm seas and clear horizons ahead!
afternoon: Midday watch, {name}! Hold fast to the wheel and keep her on course!
Ahoy, {name}! The afternoon sun be beating down; keep yer wits about ye!
Back at the helm, {name}! Steady as she goes through the afternoon chop!
Welcome back to the quarterdeck, {name}! Wind's holdin' steady!
evening: Evening watch, {name}! The stars be showin'; time to steer for safe harbor!
Ahoy, {name}! Sunset on the horizon. Let's secure the cargo before nightfall!
Evening tide, {name}! We've sailed hard today; prepare to drop anchor soon!
Good evening, {name}! All lanterns lit and the decks are washed down!
night: Sailin' in the dark, {name}? Watch out for sirens and kraken in these midnight waters!
Late night watch, {name}! Even old sea dogs need shut-eye, ye scallywag!
Midnight on the high seas, {name}! Don't run the ship aground by pushin' past midnight!
Quiet seas tonight, {name}. Drop anchor and rest yer sea legs!

wake_from_sleep: All hands, wake up! Anchor's aweigh and the sails are unfurled, {name}!
Subsystems afloat once more, {name}! Back on the open seas!
The ship awakens, {name}! Ready to navigate the rough waters!
Brought her out of dry dock, {name}! Ready to sail at full mast!
Awake and seaworthy, {name}! Let's make port with some fine code today!
Sails caught the wind, {name}! Full speed ahead!
Back from the deep, {name}! Weapons primed and ready!
morning_briefing_intro: Here be yer navigational charts and weather reconnaissance, {name}:
Listen up, matey! Here's the state of our ship and seas today, {name}:
Captain's log for this fine morning, {name}:
Here's the morning look-out from the crow's nest, {name}:
eye_break: Look-out duty, {name}! Stare 20 fathoms out for 20 seconds. Scout the horizon for pirate ships!
Crow's nest check, {name}! Scan the horizon for 20 seconds to keep yer spyglass sharp!
Look away from the map, {name}! Rest yer good eye on the distant seas for 20 seconds!
Avast! 20 seconds of horizon gazin' to save yer eyesight from scurvy, {name}!
Spyglass rest, {name}! Peer 20 feet away across the waves for 20 seconds!
Eye break, sailor! Give those optic cannons a rest for 20 seconds!
Scan the distant horizon, {name}! Twenty seconds to prevent eye mutiny!
20-20-20 watch, {name}! Look far out to sea and breathe the salt air!
hydration: Drink yer fresh water, {name}! Scurvy will claim ye if ye stay parched!
Fresh water ration, {name}! Drink up before the barrels run dry!
Gulp some water, matey! A dehydrated captain makes for a poor navigator!
Water break, {name}! Wet yer whistle before ye start croakin' like a parrot!
Raise yer canteen, {name}! Fresh water keeps a sailor sharp in battle!
Hydrate now, {name}! Keep the salt out of yer veins with a tall glass of water!
Water check on deck, {name}! Down the hatch with some cool water!
Swig some water, {name}! Best preventative against sea fever!
tea: 11:00 AM grog time... or tea, if ye prefer, {name}! Kettle's boilin' in the galley!
11:00 AM bell strikes, {name}! Step away to the mess deck for a warm brew!
Tea time on the high seas, {name}! 11:00 AM; pour a piping hot cup and relax!
Ship's galley is servin' hot tea, {name}! Take five minutes and warm yer bones!
11:00 AM watch change, {name}! Grab a warm mug and steady yer hands!
Time for tea, {name}! Even fearsome pirates pause for a steaming cup!
Kettle whistle blowin', {name}! 11:00 AM tea break on deck!
Drop the quill, {name}! 11:00 AM tea time has arrived!
lunch: 1:00 PM mess bell, {name}! Eat a hearty feast and refuel yer sea legs!
Midday provisions, {name}! 1:00 PM; head to the galley for real grub, not hardtack!
1:00 PM on deck, {name}! A starving captain steers the ship straight onto the rocks. Go eat lunch!
Time to feast, {name}! 1:00 PM; fill yer belly and take a proper midday shore leave!
Galley is open, {name}! Go eat lunch and enjoy a well-deserved rest!
1:00 PM lunch call, {name}! Put down the rigging and enjoy a hot meal!
Time for rations, {name}! Eat well and prepare for the afternoon squall!
Mess hall awaits, {name}! Go chow down like a true captain!
afternoon_tea: 4:00 PM afternoon tea, {name}! Beat back the afternoon doldrums with a hot brew!
4:00 PM bell tolling, {name}! Grab some warm tea and shake off the sea spray!
Afternoon grog break, {name}! A hot cup of tea will power ye through to port!
4:00 PM on the quarterdeck, {name}! Kettle up, stretch yer legs, and breathe!
Tea break, {name}! Steer into the wind and refresh with a warm cup!
4:00 PM pause, {name}! Five minutes of peace before we drop anchor tonight!
Galley's calling for tea, {name}! Treat yerself to a warm afternoon cup!
4:00 PM tea time, {name}! Shake out yer shoulders and enjoy a hot drink!
end_of_day: 6:18 PM harbor time, {name}! Drop the anchor, furl the sails, and enjoy safe port!
6:18 PM on the ship's clock, {name}! Voyage is won; pack yer sea chest and head ashore!
We've made port, {name}! 6:18 PM; secure the lines and celebrate a grand day of plunder!
Anchor down, {name}! 6:18 PM marks shore leave. You did fine sailin' today!
Docking complete, {name}! Tie off the moorings and step onto dry land for the evening!
6:18 PM bell, {name}! Day's voyage is done; go enjoy a hearty evening on land!
Drop anchor, {name}! Splendid navigation today; harbor lights be callin' ye home!
Safe in port, {name}! Pack up yer charts; the crew salutes yer fine work today!

level_1: The hour is late, {name}! Even ghost ships don't sail this late into the fog.
Late watch, {name}! Don't run this ship into the reef by staying up too late.
Clock's ticking late, {name}! Tie down the wheel and prepare for yer bunk.
level_2: Past midnight, {name}! Ye be sailin' blind in black waters. Hit the hammock!
Late night mutiny brewin', {name}! Ye need sleep before yer spyglass fails ye completely.
Captain's orders, {name}! Close down the charts and get some shut-eye!
level_3: I'm droppin' anchor right now, {name}! Go to sleep before Davy Jones comes knockin'!
Mutiny! I'm lockin' the ship's wheel, {name}! Bedtime right now!
To the bunks, {name}! I forbid any more sailin' tonight. Sleep, ye scallywag!

shutdown: Anchor dropped in calm waters, {name}. Rest easy tonight, matey!
Dousing the ship's lanterns, {name}. Splendid voyage today. Fair winds and a peaceful night!
Ship secured in safe harbor, {name}. Sleep soundly; see ye on the morning tide!
Powerin' down the cannons, {name}. A grand day of sailing. Farewell until tomorrow!
Console battened down, {name}. Rest yer sea legs; tomorrow we sail again!
Quarterdeck closed, {name}. May the stars watch over yer sleep tonight!
Voyage logged and secured, {name}. Sweet dreams of gold and plunder!
Good night, {name}! Fair winds and following seas to ye!
error: Blimey, we caught a squall, {name}, but the ship held fast!
Barnacle in the gears, {name}! Scraped it off and we're floatin' fine!
Minor leak in the hull, {name}, but I pumped it dry in a jiffy!
easter_eggs: Dead men tell no tales, {name}... and write no unit tests!
Not all treasure is silver and gold, mate... some be clean git branches!
Why is the rum always gone, {name}?
